messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — PineTree renewal landed in my queue. They accepted the annual term and the seat increase, but procurement needs an invoice + PO before e-sign. can we get this over the line this week? :pray:
ethan_sales: Great — thanks. I already committed the 12mo pricing (no SAAS discount beyond renewal). Procurement asked for VAT handling and a purchase order number. I can nudge them but we need AP details.
olivia_legal: Quick check — any contract term changes beyond term length & seats? if not, we can reuse the latest SOW and append the amendment. need to confirm billing entity (EU or US) for VAT.
maria_cs: No other term changes. PineTree is buying under PineTree EU Ltd per the quote. they listed a VAT ID in the form. attaching quote id: Q-4839.
jordan_ap: @maria_cs can you paste the exact billing address + VAT ID? AP needs that to generate invoice. Also we require PO number on the invoice to accept payment.
lina_csm: I'll schedule a 30m handoff with their admin to run through onboarding timeline once signed. Can we aim for e-sign by Fri? :calendar:
docusign-bot: Contract Q-4839 amendment sent to pine.admin@pinetree.eu via DocuSign at https://docusign.example/abc123 — status: sent.
ethan_sales: @jordan_ap VAT ID: GB123456789. Billing address: 12 Beacon St, London, W1 3AB. PO requested from them — they've said procurement usually issues within 48h after invoice receipt.
ojordan_ap: thanks. i'll queue a pro-forma invoice today. is the billing currency GBP or USD? we need that line on the inv.
maria_cs: Currency: GBP. note: sales approved one-time onboarding credit $2k USD as a Customer Success uplift — do we show it on invoice or handle as separate credit memo?
olivia_legal: prefer to reflect any credit on the amendment as a line item (negative) to keep contract and invoice consistent. legal ok with wording — i'll prepare an amendment snippet: 
```
One-time onboarding credit: 1,620 GBP applied against the first invoice.
```
ethan_sales: confirmed. @maria_cs mark as 1620 GBP on invoice.
jordan_ap: i'll draft invoice with PO placeholder and send to @maria_cs for review. once they return PO we will attach and reissue final. target: send pro-forma by EOD.
lina_csm: i'll include the onboarding session invite and enablement checklist in the pro-forma email so they see progress.
maria_cs: sweet. ping me if procurement stalls — i'll escalate to the customer exec. :thumbsup:
